summary: Tested Пункт 4 (configurable amoCRM cancelled/lost stage id). Backend webhook logic is fully correct (6/6 pytest): default 73620210 still cancels when cancelled_status_id is unset or blank; when settings.cancelled_status_id='88888' the 88888 webhook deletes the order while the old default 73620210 only updates it (order preserved), and the update-fallback guard honours the configured id too. POST /api/integrations/amocrm/settings persists the value in Mongo. FRONTEND FAILS the round-trip: the input saves (toast «Настройки сохранены», DB gets 55555) but after reload the field shows 73620210 again, because GET /api/integrations/amocrm/settings does not return cancelled_status_id. Same omission for section_pipelines and stage_sync => saving from the UI silently WIPES pipeline filters/stage sync (data loss on production).

critical.issue: Response omits cancelled_status_id -> UI shows the hardcoded default 73620210 after reload and re-saving overwrites the admin's configured value back to 73620210 (feature is effectively unusable from UI).

GET also omits section_pipelines and stage_sync. Frontend POSTs its full state back, so every save from the Integrations page resets section_pipelines to {greenhouse:'',balia:'',sauna:''} and stage_sync to empty. Verified live: after one UI save on preview both keys were written as empty. On production this destroys the amoCRM pipeline filters.

minor.issue: No auth dependency on the settings save/read endpoints (anyone can read/overwrite amoCRM domain/token/config).

ui_bugs.issue: Value entered in «ID стадии «Слетел заказ»» does not persist visually: save succeeds and DB stores 55555, but after page reload the field renders 73620210 (fetchSettings spreads a GET response that lacks the key, so the default state wins).

integration_issues.issue: GET /settings omits cancelled_status_id / section_pipelines / stage_sync; setSettings(prev => ({...prev, ...data})) therefore keeps stale defaults and the next save writes those defaults to DB.

issues: Mixed locale: outer tabs are Polish (Zamówienia, Integracje) while 'Планировки', 'Контент' and the entire Integrations page are Russian
Only the cancelled-status input has a data-testid in the whole IntegrationsPage; save buttons/tabs lack data-testid, making automation brittle

action_items: Add cancelled_status_id to the GET /api/integrations/amocrm/settings response so the UI input round-trips.
Also return section_pipelines and stage_sync from GET /settings (or make POST a partial merge) — currently every UI save wipes them; this is a production data-loss bug.
Consider requiring admin auth on the amoCRM settings GET/POST endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: amocrm.py get_settings() hand-builds the response dict and drifts from AmoCRMSettings/save_settings — every new field must be added in two places. Return the persisted doc (minus _id) merged with defaults instead.
save_settings() does a full $set of the Pydantic dict, so any field the client did not know about is overwritten with its default. Combined with the incomplete GET this is a silent config-reset path.
amocrm.py is 3606 lines — split into webhook / sync / settings modules.

success_rate.backend: 75% (6/8; the 2 failures are the GET /settings omissions)
success_rate.frontend: 50% (input present & editable, save OK; reload persistence FAILS)

seed_data_creation: Seeded sauna_orders amocrm_id QC1..QC6 + webhook_logs; all deleted by the test fixture. integration_settings amocrm doc snapshotted and restored; cancelled_status_id and section_pipelines unset again (verified absent, enabled=true). Note: the one UI save added empty section_pipelines/stage_sync keys — section_pipelines was unset again; stage_sync remains with empty values (behaviourally identical to absent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_amocrm_configurable_cancelled_status_iteration116.py — tests a..f must stay green, g/h should turn green once GET /settings returns cancelled_status_id + section_pipelines + stage_sync. Frontend path: login admin/admin123 -> click text 'Panel administracyjny' -> tab 'Integracje' -> inner tab 'Синхронизация' -> input [data-testid=amocrm-cancelled-status-id-input], save button named 'Сохранить настройки синхронизации'.
rca_of_the_issue: receive_webhook_section correctly reads settings.get('cancelled_status_id') so the backend behaviour is configurable and backwards compatible. The regression is in GET /api/integrations/amocrm/settings (line ~1007), which returns a hand-written dict that never got the new key; IntegrationsPage.fetchSettings merges that response over its default state (cancelled_status_id:'73620210'), so the saved value is invisible and the next save posts the default back to Mongo. The same hand-written dict already omits section_pipelines and stage_sync, so any save from the Integrations page blanks those persisted values (reproduced live on preview).
